tables.name: users
issues: password_hash was leaking into API responses from updateRole/updateStatus/updateProfile - FIXED this session (UserRepository.sanitize()).

tables.name: cases
issues: Many near-duplicate seed/test rows at the exact same lat/lng cluster (10.7769,106.7009) with names like 'case-fb-...', 'case-sync-test-...' - leftover from prior E2E test runs, not cleaned up. Not a code bug, but pollutes the duplicate-detection radius query and inflates row counts. Recommend a data-hygiene pass (delete rows whose id matches '^case-(fb|sync-test)-' pattern) outside this audit's fix budget.

tables.name: reports
issues: FIXED this session: 'visibility' column (public/community/private) was stored but never enforced on read (GET /reports and GET /reports/:id had zero auth/visibility filtering) - P1 privacy leak, now fixed at the repository layer.

tables.name: observation_media
issues: Was unreachable from the API (no upload route existed) - FIXED this session by adding POST /cases/:id/observations/:obsId/media. Verified a new row lands here via a real multipart upload.

tables.name: confirmations
issues: Unique constraint + explicit pre-check in the route already prevents duplicate confirmations, confirmed correct.

tables.name: case_updates
issues: Was getting duplicated on rapid double-submit of a status change (no idempotency guard) - FIXED this session in moderator.routes.ts handleCaseStatusUpdate. Verified with 2 concurrent forward requests -> exactly 1 new row.

tables.name: comments
issues: No frontend UI ever calls the comment-create/list endpoints (grep-verified) - backend feature exists but is entirely unreachable from the app. Not fixed (feature build, not a bug).

tables.name: content_reports
issues: ALWAYS EMPTY: no UI anywhere lets a citizen flag/report a post or comment, so this table can never receive rows even though ModerationQueuePage + its GET/action endpoints are fully wired and working against whatever would be in it. Flagged, not built (out of scope for a bug-fix pass).

tables.name: notifications
issues: Was being double-inserted per follower on a double-submitted case status change - FIXED this session (same idempotency fix as case_updates).

tables.name: user_contributions
issues: Only 11 rows total across 63 users while /me/contributions computes a much higher 'stats.totalContributions' by counting reports+observations+confirmations+task_submissions directly - the two numbers (raw counts vs this ledger table) are not kept in sync by any code path. Not a regression introduced this session; flagged for the product owner as a data-model inconsistency (the ledger table appears to be legacy/seed-only, real numbers now come from live COUNT() queries in me.routes.ts).

tables.name: impact_stats
issues: ALWAYS EMPTY: no repository method or route anywhere writes to this table (grep-verified across apps/server/src). Appears to be a dead/never-implemented daily-rollup feature. Not built (out of scope).

tables.name: case_feedback
issues: This table is not declared in db/schema.ts or db/migrate.ts at all - it is created ad-hoc via 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS' directly inside cases.routes.ts on first request, and had NO index on case_id despite every query filtering by case_id. FIXED: added case_feedback_case_idx via CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS in the same route file (using sqliteClient.exec, since the driver's .run() does not support multi-statement SQL - had to fix that too, the original multi-statement .run() call would have thrown at runtime).

duplicateRowsReproduced.doubleForwardCase: Reproduced BEFORE fix: 2 concurrent PATCH /moderator/cases/:id/status calls with the same target status produced 2 case_updates rows + 2 notifications rows for 1 case. AFTER fix: exactly 1 of each, second response carries idempotent:true. Verified by direct DB query, test rows cleaned up after.
